renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Fear-talk is denied while suffering is conceded: with You as Lord pervading own self, no talk of transmigration-fear. [1] Even though hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, terror-causing karmas stand — no-fear and full-suffering together, resolved within it, not deferred. [2] The non-dual recognition does not deny affliction; it denies fear of it.

paragraphs.text: Here is a strange combination the song insists on: there is to be no talk of fear about being reborn — because You, Lord, pervade my very self. And at the same time, nobody denies the hard stuff: suffering that is hard to bear, delusion, karmas that cause terror — all of them still standing.
Both together, resolved right here, not postponed to later. That is the point: non-dual recognition does not pretend pain is not there. It denies fear of pain, not pain itself.
